sources.snippet: CrossEncoder based on ncbi/MedCPT-Cross-Encoder This is a Cross Encoder model finetuned from ncbi/MedCPT-Cross-Encoder using the sentence-transformers library. It computes scores for pairs of texts, which can be used for text reranking and semantic search. sources.title: Domain-wide Mapping of Peer-reviewed Literature for Genetic ...
sources.snippet: The natural language processing system combines a fine-tuned BERT classifier (LitDD BERT) to detect GDD-relevant abstracts, a fine-tuned cross-encoder (LitDD Crossencoder) to propose disease candidates, and a constrained large language model to adjudicate final mappings.

sources.title: CrossEncoder Architecture | huggingface/sentence-transformers | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page documents the CrossEncoder architecture, a core model type in the Sentence Transformers library designed for joint encoding of text pairs to produce similarity scores or classification labels.
